QuestInfo.name: Helping the Town 1
QuestInfo.0: Ayan was wondering if you wanted to help the village. Ask her what you can do.
QuestInfo.1: Looks like you can train and help the village at the same time! Go to #m102020000# by following the arrow signs, eliminate Stumps, and bring Tree Branches back to the village.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated a bunch of Stumps, and got a bunch of Tree Branches for the village. Everyone wins!

0.0: Hello. You must be #h0#. Dances with Barlog said you were coming. Welcome to Perion.
0.1: I'm not actually from Perion, either. The people here took me in when they found me. I had lost my memory, you see. It was tough, but the people here were so good to me. They're quite strong and noble. Well, except for Blackbull. He's a jerk.
0.2: Here in the dry mountains life is tough, so the people of Perion must be tougher. There is always something that must be done. Feel like helping the town out? There's only one right answer to this question, y'know.

yes.0: Great. I need some tree branches for the town. Please eliminate 30 Stumps outside of town, and get 10 Tree Branches from them. You can practice your skills and help the town out at the same time!
yes.1: You'll find plenty of Stumps if you follow the arrow sign to the #m102020000#. Good luck!

no.0: ...No, that was the WRONG answer. Try again. Continued wrong answers MAY be punished.

yes.0: Good work! We'll use these Tree Branches for all kinds of things around town. Here, give me a moment to prepare them, and then we'll move on to your next task.

item.0: I said I need 10 Tree Branches. Do you have 10 Tree Branches? No. Do you see the problem here?

mob.0: ...When I said 'Please eliminate 30 Stumps', that meant eliminate 30 Stumps. It was not a suggestion. Do it.
